scope: Existing 36 baseline attempts; no commands replayed, no task-private/answer sources inspected, no runtime edits or new runs. Only existing observed behavior and metadata assessed.

metric_notes.input_tokens: Per-generation input sums input + input_cached_tokens + input_cache_write_tokens; summed values exactly match every local run input total. Peak uses individual generation input, not cumulative replay.
metric_notes.request_bytes: Reconstruct original make_responder request from exported input/tools/parallel_tool_calls plus recorded model/reasoning/max_output_tokens/store/include, JSON ensure_ascii=True. Not pre-request instrumentation.
metric_notes.timing: active_s is runner monotonic active interval; launch_s is broader run total. Hosted timing anomaly identified separately; durations not conflated.
metric_notes.cost: Local configured-rate estimate and native generation totalCost are distinct accounting bases; native includes cache-write pricing. Not invoice reconciliation.
